shader_converter.role: Hard dependency: LC_LOAD_DYLIB of the XeniOS executable; MetalCommandProcessor::Initialize fails without it on both guest-shader paths (gpu/metal/metal_command_processor.cc:2619-2624).
shader_converter.license: Apple software under Apple's own terms (the XeniOS IPA's Acknowledgements.json says so); the Apache-2.0 LICENSE in third_party/metal-shader-converter covers the headers only. Redistribution permission is not established in this repository.
shader_converter.supply: Fetched at build time from the upstream mirror below (pinned pointer, digest-checked, Apple code signature verified with codesign on macOS), or supplied out of band by the builder; never committed, rehosted, attached to public artifacts or extracted from a third-party IPA. Including it in a published RewindBox IPA is a maintainer/legal decision.
shader_converter.headers: third_party/metal-shader-converter at the pinned revision, IR_VERSION 4.0.1
shader_converter.required_exports_note: Every IR* function the pinned XeniOS sources call that the library must export (33 of the 45 IR* names they call; the other 12 are header-implemented runtime helpers such as the IRRuntime* tessellator tables, or enum types).

upstream_mirror.upstream_license_statement: Apple software under « Software License Agreement for Metal Shader Converter » EA1844 (assets/legal/metal-shader-converter/, maintainer's dossier docs/evidence/xenia-metal-shader-converter/); the headers alone are Apache-2.0. Redistribution allowed by the maintainer (12 Nov 2026); open points (1) EA1844 vs this ios-4.0.3 runtime, (2) provenance, (3) re-signing under 2.E are not resolved.
upstream_mirror.relation_to_reference: Downloaded and compared on 2026-11-10: identical bytes from offset 4096 to LC_CODE_SIGNATURE dataoff 29936976 (same Apple build, source version 33.39); only the Mach-O header page and the code signature differ (Apple's signature here, XeniOS's re-signing in the IPA).
upstream_mirror.signature_free_note: validate_shader_converter.signature_free_digest: the image before its code signature, LC_CODE_SIGNATURE dataoff/datasize and __LINKEDIT vmsize/filesize zeroed. Equal (checked 12 Nov 2026) for this Apple-signed mirror asset and for the copy XeniOS 2.3.1 ships re-signed (923caf5d...). The IPA copy must match it (agreement EA1844 clause 2.E: unmodified apart from the signature iOS requires).
